chips.title: Initial tali plugin
chips.summary: voice-mutate, voice-review and voice-publish skills plus the page, site and PDF build tools, extracted from a 26-document by 3-voice production round.

evidence.message: Single initial commit 2026-08-23; no commits since.
Plugin content is unchanged since the initial commit; the only later commit authored the chip board. Two commits total, main level with the remote.

chips.title: masq profiles as voice specs
chips.summary: Documented how a masq profile or tone style guide serves as a voice spec, so interactive personas and published voices share one source.

evidence.message: Integration note shipped with the initial commit.
In live use: the masq dean and de-tell profiles defer to tali for document voice passes and name its AI-ism flag list as the companion to keep in sync.

chips.title: Publish and install through the plugin marketplace
chips.summary: Repo pushed to the public remote, registered as a marketplace, and installed on the authoring machine; all three skills resolve in live sessions.

evidence.message: Marketplace clone dated 2026-08-23 sits at the initial commit; the plugin is enabled in user settings and its skills load in the session that authored this board.

chips.title: Define repeatable fidelity validation
chips.summary: A fidelity check anyone can rerun on a document set with pass or fail output, replacing the one-off adversarial review from the originating round.

evidence.message: Named as the next step by the 2026-09-05 status reassessment.
No work since 2026-09-05. The skills still describe an agent-run adversarial review; the repo has no script, fixture, or test that emits a pass or fail result.
Added a rerunnable fidelity check with pass or fail exit status, an example config, a good and a broken fixture voice, and 12 passing tests; skills now require it.

chips.title: Prove installation outside the origin
chips.summary: Install from the marketplace on a machine that never held the source clone and run voice-mutate on a document from a different campaign.

evidence.message: Second half of the status remaining summary.
Marketplace install is proven only on the authoring machine. No clean-machine install and no run against a non-origin document have been attempted.

chips.title: Reuse on a second campaign
chips.summary: Run the full multi-voice round on a second real document campaign and compare effort against the first.

evidence.message: Still no campaign selected. No project in the workspace carries a site config for the publish tools besides the example shipped with the plugin.
